style: Soul Knight in-game pixel treatment on ORIGINAL character silhouettes only. Do not redesign shapes.
pipeline: tools/art-hd/*-hd.png → crop → 64px grid → flatten color steps → 1px outline → nearest upscale 256

fish.note: Keep original DeepSeek mascot silhouette; only pixelize shading/edges.

squirrel.note: Keep original Faker squirrel silhouette (hat/glasses/pear body); only pixelize.

loadingBanner.note: Soul Knight loading poster. STRICT likeness: hero = deepseek-fish (blue chibi girl hat IV), enemies = faker-squirrel (pear rodent flat-cap glasses). No literal fish body. Nearest-neighbor 720x404.

loadingSplash.note: 720x1280 engine splash: LoadingUi chrome around loading-banner.png (title + frame + bar at 35%).
